exposure: Women with GDM who developed type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)
Women with GDM who did not develop T2DM
cohort: First Nations women in northwest Ontario with a history of GDM
finding: The study found that the cumulative incidence of T2DM among women with a history of GDM was 18% at 2 years and 39% at 6 years.
